t: What Rare Disease Diagnostic Database Is All About
title: What Rare Disease Diagnostic Database Is All About
description: Rare diseases (fewer than 1 in 2,000 people in the EU) number 7,000+, yet collectively affect 300 million people. Diagnosis takes 5+ years on average — the 'diagnostic odyssey.' Cystic fibrosis (CFTR, 1 in 3,500 births), Huntington's (CAG repeats, dominant), and progeria (LMNA, 1 in 20 million) each have genetic tests that end the search. Whole-exome sequencing now solves ~30-40% of undiagnosed cases. Reference information, not medical advice. This database is the complete rare disease: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
